Package.Name: Spotify
Package.Author: Elie Bertret
Package.Description: Now-playing and volume control for Spotify via the official Web API - reflects the account's active playback regardless of which device is actually outputting audio (phone, soundbar, this Edge node's own speakers, anything), using a one-time OAuth authorization.

Setting.name: SpotifyConfiguration
Setting.description: Spotify Web API app credentials (from developer.spotify.com) and the refresh token obtained via the one-time OAuth authorization, plus polling interval
